name: Passing
desc: Vision, lobs, skips and fancy passes.

nodes.name: Floor General
nodes.desc: +4 Pass Speed and Range. Passing lanes are drawn: green = safe, red = risky.

nodes.name: Lob City
nodes.desc: Lobs (hold △) are more accurate, harder to tip and reach further (alley-oops from 50 ft instead of 35). Passes to cutters near the rim also go over the top on their own.

nodes.name: Skip Pass
nodes.desc: Long cross-court passes are safe from further away.

nodes.name: Dimer
nodes.desc: Teammates shooting right off your pass get x1.06.

nodes.name: Magic
nodes.desc: Fancy passes, on their own when they fit: a receiver off to your side gets a no-look, one behind you gets a behind-the-back, and on a drive with a man in front you wrap it around him. Fancy passes are harder to pick off (x0.6), track the receiver harder and are easier to catch.
